content.heading: seventh post (#meta, #quarkus)
content: well it seems there is no nice way to launch [quarkus](https://quarkus.io/) from [picocli](https://picocli.info/) with submenus. i've just spent the last 6 hours troubleshooting the submenu system built with [jline](https://jline.readthedocs.io/) and the reasons why it wouldn't launch the frontend due to missing CDI. the solution was letting it all go and just rewriting everything with manual CDI injection
![cdi](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/akinevz2/frontend/blog-posts/cdi.png)

content.heading: resolution
content.content: Quarkus application class is intended to be implemented when adding functionality that has to run before the quarkus application starts. I instructed CoPilot to refactor the app to show the menus and launch the app in the background so that CDI is resolved

content.heading: curiosity
content.content: i wanted to discuss my findings in qwen3.5, specifically how I managed to get it to produce useful output and terminate in one session, after 1 chat message, followed by an interrupt, followed by another request

content.heading: ramble
content: the model refused to terminate aggressively, running on consumer hardware, on a baseline ollama instance.
a simple query of 'what are your patchnotes' resulted in a non-terminating process where the model was attempting to look up knowledge, but was getting distracted with the formatting of the output.
the model refused to interpret the statement relating to its output shape as a hint, rather using it as an excuse to keep producing more output.

interrupting the model, and adding a guidance interpreted from its partial output managed to produce a extremely lengthy response, but one that finished with the clause of formatting being slightly misinterpreted.
what i found interesting was the fact that the model did manage to not only give an innacurate answer,
it also managed to think itself into contradicting itself

it carried on making the assumption that its knowledge was correct and current at any given timeframe immutable and reasoned from there to conclude that the formatting directive provided to it, was to be doubted as malicious information.

the guidance it was given to simplify the response to one statement was skipped, somehow the request to format the ouput as 5 plain text lines proved troublesome to the model, despite supposedly being adept at transforming basic text, as well as structured data.
the implied freedom to respond without forced text formatting was sidestepped.
the model chose to format the text specifically into 5 lines, be that when giving a valid response, or notifying of an error
no concrete contract was made with the model, perhaps causing more trouble than not
